data.one_liner: Dart SDK for Nhost authentication and file storage APIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to sign users in, manage sessions, and upload, download, or replace files on Nhost storage. It abstracts HTTP calls to the Nhost backend.
use_when: You need direct Nhost auth and storage access in a pure Dart or Flutter app
You prefer a lightweight client without Firebase or Supabase dependencies
avoid_when: You need a full-featured UI auth flow (use nhost_dart or nhost_flutter_auth)
You require code generation for models (this package has none)
strengths: Supports latest Nhost features like metadata on sign‑in and file replace
Works across all Dart platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
No codegen required, simple imperative API
weaknesses: Only low‑level SDK; no ready‑made UI widgets
Documentation advises not to use it directly in Flutter projects

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple key‑value storage instead of Nhost file storage

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: When you need secure local storage rather than remote Nhost storage

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a local SQLite database over remote file storage
